evidence: Running bash run_repro.sh reaches TypeError in codebase/kornia/geometry/depth.py:55 because unproject_meshgrid enforces camera_matrix shape ['3', '3'] while depth_to_3d_v2 passes a batched tensor with shape torch.Size([4, 3, 3]).
steps: Created an isolated environment with setup_env.sh and installed the minimal runtime dependencies.
Ran repro.py with depth shape (4, 512, 512) and batched intrinsics shape (4, 3, 3).
Observed the runtime TypeError raised from KORNIA_CHECK_SHAPE in unproject_meshgrid.
